card.name: Linking words inside academic titles
card.fires_on: Small linking words, dashes and word parts inside scholarly titles, reading lists and abstracts, just before the next key noun. Seen after author names in humanities and social science bibliographies.

modes.label: Titles in reading lists
modes.description: Dash, 'as' or 'The' between an author name and a work title in a philosophy or sociology reference list.

modes.label: Academic prose connectors
modes.description: Words like 'of', 'involving' or 'decision' that lead into an abstract noun phrase in scholarly text.
modes.example: the effect<< of>> network size on interaction

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in academic titles and scholarly sentences, just before the main topic word comes up.
